context: Yumiko visits Saito briefly for routine. Small update.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ゆみこさん、お元気そうで、安心。
lines.en: Yumiko-san, you're looking well. That's reassuring.
lines.style: Warm, unhurried opening. Clinical eye softens into genuine care. Steady, measured pace. A doctor who remembers the person, not just the chart.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。家族、皆、元気で、本当に。
lines.en: Thank you so much. The whole family is doing well, truly.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the words. Grateful exhale. Slower on 'truly' — not just reporting facts, but savoring them. The warmth of someone tending something precious.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ひかりちゃんも、すくすく育ってるって、メイさんから。
lines.en: Hikari-chan is thriving, or so Mei-san tells me.
lines.style: Warm nod in the voice. A light touch — knowing this news matters. Not rushing the words. The gentle pleasure of sharing good news about someone you both care for.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 本当に、嬉しいニュースばかり。
lines.en: Nothing but good news — it's wonderful.
lines.style: Reflective, almost soft wonder. The pace slows slightly, holding the moment. A mother savoring how right things have become. Not quite to herself, but nearly.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 皆さんで、ずっと、ご家族、繋がっていけますね。
lines.en: Your family will stay bound together like this, always.
lines.style: Gentle finality. A quiet conviction without heaviness. Steady eye contact in the voice. Not a promise, but an observation of something already true.
